text:
Nora (CSM): Quick heads-up: Seabreeze asked for a pre-QBR spend sanity check. They saw an unexpected embed surge and want a simple 90-day forecast + an ops checklist and guardrail they can enable immediately. Renewal is ~45 days. Can FinOps + Analytics produce conservative/expected/high scenarios and a proposed alert rule? cc @Liam @Jia
Liam (FinOps): On it. I'll output billed tokens using $0.00046/token and include tokens/day, $/day, $/month. Also can add a short note on reserved throughput vs on-demand — but main deliverable is immediate mitigations.
Jia (Analytics): Running route breakout now. SQL I'm running: ```SELECT day, route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE account='seabreeze' GROUP BY day, route ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 120;``` Will attach CSV and p95 per route.
Carlos (AE): Context: they enabled embeddings for product search and a nightly full-reindex job. Onboarding at ~62%. They specifically requested per-route spend on the invoice.
spend-bot: [automated] Anomaly detected for seabreeze: 3-day avg tokens rose 2.6x on 2026-07-08. Baseline route "search-embed" p95=46k/day.
Ria (Enablement): I can run a 30-min "Embed cost triage" workshop: caching, route quotas, and SDK batching. Will include a copy-paste alert webhook + example rate-limit config. Proposed Mon 10am PT.
Nora (CSM): Good. Liam  please prepare three rows labeled conservative/expected/high and include a sensitivity column (+10/25/50%). Also include a suggested short-term credit cap or invoice notification we can offer to the customer.
Liam (FinOps): Will do. Draft guard rule for the playbook: ```if route('search-embed').avg24h > baseline*2.5 then notify('#cs-cost') and POST /webhooks/customer-alerts {"acct":"seabreeze","reason":"token_spike"}; set_temp_cap(30k/day)``` I'll explain cap implications in the CSV.
Jia (Analytics): Uploaded CSV -> https://files.redwood/seabreeze-90d-forecast.csv. Quick notes: median daily tokens overall=21k; two outliers from full-reindex >160k; route p95 for search-embed = 52k. Added 90-day rolling median + p95 chart.
Carlos (AE): I'll ask their infra lead to stagger re-index and confirm which routes are non-critical so we can throttle them. Also pushing renewal conversation earlier given sensitivity.
Ria (Enablement): Example dashboard rule for the one-pager: "if route(search-embed).p95 > baseline*2 then post to #cs-ops and apply rate_limit(70%) on route=search-embed for 2h". I'll include an SDK snippet that toggles prefix caching TTL and batching size.
spend-bot: [automated] Scheduled summary will post at 14:30 PT with updated route metrics.
Nora (CSM): Can we meet 15:30 PT today to finalize the one-pager + enablement invite? Target deliverable: one-page with 3-row forecast table, recommended alert rule, quick ops checklist, and enablement time.
Liam (FinOps): 15:30 PT works. I'll have the forecast table + cap proposal and a short note on reserved throughput options if they plan sustained high usage.
Jia (Analytics): I'll join with charts and the CSV. Also added a short baseline calc: median of last 30 days + smoothing to ignore reindex outliers.
Carlos (AE): I'll coordinate with the customer to accept a 1-hr maintenance window to shift reindex and sign up for the enablement session.
Ria (Enablement): I'll prepare the 1-pager and copy-paste alert configs. Can share 30m before the sync.
Nora (CSM): Thanks all  — priority is to give Seabreeze a predictable bill path and a short checklist they can run during onboarding week. Let's avoid surprises in the renewal call. :thumbsup:
